utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — what time should I be there for carpool?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: About 7:30, if that still works for you. Thank you — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, 7:30 works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do it, but I need the exact pickup time and route first so I can plan around traffic.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the pickup time and route, then?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — send me the pickup time and the route, and I’ll confirm whether I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — carpool. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m in if there’s still a spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I think there’s still room — I just need to double-check the latest list. I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren — appreciate it. Just let me know when you confirm, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll tell everyone the carpool plan and make sure the timing’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out and make sure everyone knows the timing too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass along the carpool timing and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we’re leaving in about ten minutes, and I can grab the last seat if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate that. I’ll head over now and meet you by the car.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a simple plan: who’s driving, what time, and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can drive. Let’s meet at the corner by 8:15, and I’ll head out right after everyone’s in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Quinn. I’ll be at the corner by 8:15 and ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s driving for the carpool, and what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can drive, and I’ll be there around 7:30. Just be ready by then and we’ll head out together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Should I wait outside or meet you by the curb?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help sync everyone up for the carpool — what time and who’s riding?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ve got three riders: Mia, Ben, and me. Let’s plan to leave at 7:30 AM from my place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll lock in 7:30 AM from your place for you, Mia, and Ben. If anything changes, just text me and I’ll update everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days or times are we trying to cover?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — we’re mainly covering weekday school drop-off and pickup, with the biggest gaps on Tuesdays and Thursdays. I’m putting together a simple schedule now, and I’d love to slot you in where it works best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — Tuesdays and Thursdays are good for me, and I can help with either drop-off or pickup. Send me the schedule when it’s ready, and I’ll fill in the spots that fit.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for the carpool—just tell me what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, thanks. We’re mostly short on napkins and bottled water.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ll make a note for napkins and bottled water, and I’ll check what else we need before the next ride.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, I heard the carpool’s still on for this week—want me to check if anyone needs a pickup?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, please—if you can check, that’d be great. Thanks, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know if anyone needs a ride.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the carpool details one more time so I make sure I’ve got them right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I’ll send the pickup time, drop-off spot, and which days we’re driving so it’s all clear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ll wait for the pickup time, drop-off spot, and driving days so I can confirm I’ve got everything right.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira, I’m in for the carpool—just send me the time and pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great — I’ll text you the time and pickup spot as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep my phone handy and wait for your text.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can take the first shift, and then we can swap off next week.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works great — thanks, Vik. We can swap next week and keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll do this week and we’ll swap next week. That should keep the carpool easy for both of us.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. I think it’s still on, unless something changed and I missed it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s still on. I’ll be there unless something comes up last minute.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’ll see you there. If anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can help with the carpool. What days do you need covered?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — I need Monday and Wednesday covered, if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can take Monday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m happy to help coordinate the carpool. What days and times are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa. I’m thinking weekdays around 8:15 AM and 5:30 PM—can you help with those times?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help with those times. Let’s map out which weekdays you need and who’s available for each pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the pickup timing and parking, so could we lock down the exact stop and time?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s lock it in: same curb by the community center, pickup at 7:15 sharp. I’ll text the exact spot and a backup parking note so it’s easy.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps a lot — I just want to make sure the curb spot is clear and we’re all set if traffic slows things down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, is the carpool definitely happening today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to check the details first before I say for sure — let me confirm and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks. Please let me know as soon as you’ve confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: what time are we leaving, and who’s riding first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the first ride — I’m good to leave at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — 7:30 works for me. I’ll ride first, and we can keep the rest of the schedule simple from there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a little behind—what’s the latest on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still set for the usual pickup, but I can double-check the headcount and let you know if anyone’s missing. If you need, I can also sort out who’s bringing the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—could you check the headcount and let me know if I should bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the carpool. I’m a little foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help sort it out with you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — I’m happy to sort it out too. I think we just need to confirm the pickup time and who’s riding with us.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that sounds right. Let’s pick a time and make a quick rider list so I don’t mix anything up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the carpool—what time does school let out, and who needs a ride?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: School lets out at 3:15, and it’s just Mia and Owen who need a ride.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I can pick them up at 3:15. Where should I meet them for pickup?
